第 3 天/

posts.original:
Day 3/

The big one is GPT-6 in Chat, but today is also a little celebration day with a new high of 40M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work.

Loading a banked reset in everyone's paid accounts. See you again tomorrow!

posts.text:
我们发布了四件被认为从不错到很棒的东西，还有一些数学证明，但投票结果很明确，社区要求一次重置。我确实做了校准，看起来这个游戏规则偏向重置，但目前的规则就是这样。

因此……重置已经处理完毕。尽情享用！
posts.original:
We shipped four things that were deemed good to great and some math proofs, but the vote is clear and the community demands a reset. I did calibrate it and it *seems* that the game is rigged in reset's favor, but such are the rules at the moment.

Therefore ... the reset has been processed. Enjoy!

activities.text: 周末有报告称，部分用户的用量消耗速度比预期更快。我们已识别出约 40,000 个账户，这些账户在用量额度上存在不一致，即实际应用的用量与其实际所选套餐不符。我们正在逐一联系所有这些用户，并已修正该问题。如果你受到影响，我们会向你的账户添加额度。抱歉我们搞错了。
activities.original: There were reports of usage draining faster than anticipated for some users over the weekend. We've identified approximately 40,000 accounts that had an inconsistency on which usage limits where the actual usage that was applied did not correspond to their actual selected plan. We are reaching out individually to all these users and have corrected the issue. If this affected you, we'll add credits to your account. Sorry we got this wrong.
